proposal_under_review: Original true point-supported fine-middle-coarse undirected forest. h0 is original3LN(raw). Each component uses exactly its genuine tree diameter D synchronous rounds: mean every original neighbor OLDstate, concatenate own OLDstate and that mean, one shared2C-toC/GELU simultaneously replaces all active node states. Finished components get no fake rounds. Final3states are private deltas before original raw skips/HCG/singleinst. No implementation reviewed by this proposal file.

nearest_graph_differences.difference: PES uses a deterministic Euler closed walk then reverse, one current sender/current receiver update per event. SFC adds an all-neighbor reduction and simultaneous old-state update of every active node; even a single true fine-middle-coarse chain has an internal degree2 neighbor mean absent from a PES cell. This is not merely a scalar round-count change, but remains a related recurrent graph family.

CTS keeps only middle siblings inside each original coarse-parent geometric cycle, synchronous own/+3^r/-3^r3-slot maps for ceil(log3 n) coverage. SFC updates original fine/middle/coarse membership-forest nodes using adjacency degree means and component tree diameter, not that same graph or slot composition.
HPC uses fixed linear tree-resolvent S, three original scale-specific nonlinear FFNs once, then fixed S. SFC has finite repeated shared nonlinear node-state updates and no resolvent or retained FFNs.

DCE has recipient-specific directed cavity edges, reverse-message exclusion and six role-specific maps/readouts. SFC intentionally permits feedback/backtracking through persistent node states and full neighbor means with one shared map. It must not claim physical self-information exclusion.

explicit_ban_interpretation.private_neighbor_mean: A private degree-fixed state-message mean does not alter original raw aggregation/FPS/memberships or introduce learned pool/selector weights. It is not a blanket exemption to changing those original paths.
explicit_ban_interpretation.no_new_attention_gate_QKV_point_routing: Original cluster-level forest edges only; no QKV/softmax/learned routing/new gate or point N-squared relation. Original existing HCG/instance gate remains original.
explicit_ban_interpretation.no_extra_residual_or_injection: Every round replaces persistent state; do not silently add raw/state residuals or repeated point/instance injection. Original three LN calls only before h0, and final three raw skips/HCG/singleinst remain.
explicit_ban_interpretation.no_held_reopen_or_failure_rename: This does not repair or explain the archived PES gradient-clipping parameter-iteration crash, nor reopen RSTR/numerical/supervision/M206 holds or their authorization/revision limits.

implementation_boundaries_if_root_select: Construct only actual unique point-supported fine nodes and their exact middle/coarse ancestors; no fake padding/self-loop/donor or cross-scene edges.

Use exact unweighted mean over all original adjacent nodes. A middle neighbor set is its parent plus supported fine children, with denominator1+childcount; do not mean childmean and parent as two equally weighted groups.
Gather all receivers and all donor OLDstates for a round before any state replacement. Per-component stage barriers matter; an in-place Gauss-Seidel loop is a different graph.

Actual legal nonempty components have diameter2 with one supported middle child, otherwise4; empty support has no component and yields zero delta. Test mixed2/4 components and retain completed component states rather than extra fake updates.
Final original-ID scatter keeps unsupported/padding deltas zero. Original raw/FPS/CSORT/HCG/three-LN/final raw skips/single instance path and original YAML/data/seed/precision remain.

limitations_and_future_measurement: This is a standard synchronous message-passing/GNN-style family, not a claim of research novelty, new information, task deficit, coverage discovery or efficacy. Tree-diameter potential reachability does not guarantee actual learned nonzero influence or task improvement. Oversmoothing, feedback/repeated self-information, degree averaging, shared role capacity, gradient strength and measured wall time remain uncertain. A future original-TRAIN2 whole-core aggregate weight gradient/update control may be used without per-node/column/call/bias positivity or new FP32/Jacobian/conservation gates. Unexercised degree/diameter/empty boundaries must be reported, not resampled into a pass.
